firmware_pointer.native_sources: channel+68 CPU pointer array, channel+90 FW ring, state+8

accelerator_transport.role: routes queue-state address and pointer-ring next-write boundary through stage_queue/flush; no KSM entry bytes

concrete_mismatches.issue: lane.ring is firmware pointer ring but advertised as hardware KSM resource
concrete_mismatches.correction: Allocate separate retained capacity*512 KSM RAM and map its complete device/FW extent; config15 pair points to that resource, channel state+8 retains lane.ring.

concrete_mismatches.issue: configuration helper couples config hardware ring FW address to self.ring firmware pointer ring
concrete_mismatches.correction: Separate explicit KsmAliases(device,firmware,capacity,stride) argument from channel Inputs.ring. Never reuse one address as both roles.

identity.linux_binding: Leases.work_queue_id[stage], allocated/retained same owning queue; not DRM public queue_id, engine, routing lane or hardware_buffer_id
identity.firmware_queue_payload: channel+80 firmware queue-state ADDRESS, serialized KSM+18; separate descriptor448 command FW ADDRESS at KSM+10
identity.dependency_identity: event-machine dependency record index0..23 is distinct; do not substitute arbitrary allocated QoS ID without mapping proof

counter.submitted: Original queue+48 before encoding, returned by complete native wrapper and used opcode12/14/16
counter.next: advanced queue+48 after encoding, used only for next slot
counter.slot: submitted&255; require slot<capacity before planning write
counter.pending: queue+44 old pending must be below capacity; native increment then equality diagnostic is not safe admission
counter.cache: queue+98 bit0=1 and queue+a0=original submitted after success

count.update: caller initialized count; add extra NOP count before real 3D entry; increment once after actual entry
count.postkick14: low16 of accumulated count; extra+1 from initialized zero
count.padding_guard: difference=(current-baseline) mod2^32; extra=((difference>>8)-1) mod2^32; require extra<selected_scheduler.capacity
count.ordinary_no_padding_policy: count1 is conditional on retained event-machine current/baseline proving extra0, or explicit Linux experimental policy; do not call it generic native behavior
count.notification_masks: real3D mask high flags differ from zero NOP mask

integration_order: Retain distinct channel cursor/pointer-ring, scheduler slot, KSM resource and leased identities before configuration.
Prepare KSM entry at submitted low-byte slot; job result returns both submitted and next timestamps.
Keep entry preparation/accounting tentative until all job/postkick outputs succeed; discard on errors.
Make KSM bytes visible before publishing postkick command pointers; then publish pointer-ring next-write and accelerator transport; ordering/coherency implementation remains caller obligation.
Commit next timestamp/pending/cache once; preserve all leases and backing until authoritative completion or uncertain outcome.
limitations: Numeric source-role review reuses saved whole-native comparisons; no repeated audits.
No live allocation, mapping, DMA, kick, firmware consumption or retirement validation.
Native dependency event identity and padding policy still require actual retained runtime providers.
